elements.text: Thanks for answering our questions! In two weeks, you'll get an app notification reminding you to complete the next set of surveys. In the meantime, you can explore the homepage to learn more about Mindtrails and find resources tied to different areas that may cause stress. Have any questions for us? Contact the team at HoosThinkCalmly@gmail.com! We would be happy to schedule a Zoom call to address any questions or concerns you may have.
